hint_2: It's a grandfather reading a book to a sick kid, except the book contains sword fights, torture machines, and the most quotable Sicilian in cinema history.
hint_3: I'm going to need you to search your memory more aggressively. "As you wish." "Inconceivable." "My name is Inigo Montoya, you killed my father, prepare to die."
hint_4: The title is the female lead's eventual marital status. Two words.
